newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds must close over 114-05 for upside.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds must close over 114-05 for upside.

text.p: September T-bond futures must close above 114-05 near term if the market is to have a crack at the 115-00 handle, technical analysts said on Tuesday.

"But I think it may have a bit of trouble against that level short term -- there may be one more dip before the market rallies so I'd be a bit cautious," said Adrian Sells, director of Crane Investment Analysis in London.
Sells noted the market had cleared that level -- the August 7 low -- on Monday, but failed to hold it at the close, leaving a slightly negative tone to the contract.
"We really need to close above 114-05 to signal this market could rally to test 115-06. That was the August 7 high where we got to in the consolidation phase before the last major sell-off," he said.
Sells added a break above 114-12 intraday, Monday's high, would also be a positive signal for the market.
By 0908 GMT, September T-bonds were down 2/32 at 114-01.
Analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said in a note the picture for the market was still bullish, though an hourly sell in stochastics suggested a minor pull-back was possible.
"Look for strong support in the 113-31/27 range to turn back any nascent price weakness," they said.
"A sustained move above 114-15 -- a 50 percent retracement and high volume area -- would open us to the 62 percent retracement at 115-02 and the sub-wave high at 115-06," they added.
Sells said there was a minor prop at Friday's close of 113-20 which held the market on Monday. But after that, there was nothing particularly substantial until 112-20, he added.
